_about: Inputs of the force-allocation explainer. World x right, z up, +y into the drawing; moments about the box centre O, tau_y positive clockwise. All forces act on the box. Contact 1 is left, contact 2 is right; normals point inward, positive tangent is upward. Squeeze is the normal compression per finger. The cap is an illustrative screening limit, not a hardware rating.

x._unit: m, centre-of-mass offset from O, right positive

squeeze._unit: N per finger; the maximum is the current cap

tolerance._about: Absolute tolerances in N and N m. Equality with a friction limit or with the cap counts as feasible (a limiting case without reserve); presets match by value within tolerance.match.

centered.label: Centered
centered.question: If both fingers squeeze harder, does the upward support change?

minimum.label: Minimum
minimum.question: What is the least squeeze per finger that still balances the box?

offset.label: Offset +1 cm
offset.question: Which finger carries more weight, and whose limit is reached first?

over-cap.label: Over the cap
over-cap.question: Can any squeeze within the cap supply enough friction?

mirror.label: Mirror −1 cm
mirror.question: With the load mirrored to the left, which finger carries more?
